jsonld.name: Innersense & Kneads
jsonld.description: Massage and bodywork studio in Brandon, FL run by licensed massage therapist Angela F. Lang, LMT. Deep tissue, therapeutic, Lomi Lomi and Swedish massage, post-operative lymphatic drainage and energy healing.

parrafo.es: La terapeuta licenciada Angela F. Lang combina masaje Deep Tissue, Terapéutico, Lomi Lomi y Sueco con drenaje linfático post-operatorio especializado y energy healing, en un estudio tranquilo y personalizado en Brandon.
parrafo.en: Licensed massage therapist Angela F. Lang blends Deep Tissue, Therapeutic, Lomi Lomi and Swedish massage with specialized post-operative lymphatic drainage and energy healing, in a calm, one-on-one studio in Brandon.

hero.imagen_alt: Relaxing head and scalp massage session at Innersense & Kneads, Brandon FL

parrafo_1.es: Innersense & Kneads es el estudio de masaje y bodywork de Angela F. Lang, terapeuta de masaje con licencia (LMT MA106899) en Brandon, FL. Cada sesión es uno a uno: masaje Deep Tissue, Terapéutico, Lomi Lomi o Sueco, adaptado a lo que tu cuerpo necesita ese día.
parrafo_1.en: Innersense & Kneads is the massage and bodywork studio of Angela F. Lang, a licensed massage therapist (LMT MA106899) based in Brandon, FL. Every session is one-on-one: Deep Tissue, Therapeutic, Lomi Lomi or Swedish massage, tailored to what your body needs that day.

parrafo_2.es: Angela también se especializa en drenaje linfático post-operatorio para quienes se recuperan de procedimientos estéticos o médicos, un programa dedicado de Recuperación del Cuarto Trimestre para nuevas mamás, y energy healing para ayudar a soltar lo que el cuerpo ha estado cargando.
parrafo_2.en: Angela also specializes in post-operative lymphatic drainage for clients recovering from cosmetic or medical procedures, a dedicated Fourth Trimester Recovery program for new mothers, and energy healing to help release what the body has been holding onto.
